stories.title: Showers arriving soon in Las Vegas. More coming later this week
stories.summary: A series of Pacific storms is creating an “unsettled” week of weather for the valley, the National Weather Service said.

stories.title: UNLV football: Three plays can make all the difference in winning
stories.summary: Rebels coach Dan Mullen points to how many players graded out as champions in beating New Mexico compared to a loss against Wyoming.

stories.title: Nevada lawmaker resigns after re-election
stories.summary: Democratic Assemblymember Selena Torres-Fossett is resigning from her northwest Las Vegas district seat after being re-elected to a fifth term, citing the upcoming arrival of her son.

stories.title: Fernando Mendoza ‘showed poise’ in his first Raiders start, Klint Kubiak says
stories.summary: The Raiders lost in Fernando Mendoza’s first career start Sunday, 21-13 to the Seattle Seahawks, but coach Klint Kubiak seemed encouraged Monday by how this year’s top draft pick played.

stories.title: ‘DUI is a choice’: Judge orders prison in crash that killed man near Strip
stories.summary: He was over the legal alcohol limit and hit another car before driving away and striking the victim’s, according to an arrest report.

stories.title: More than $220K won on Wheel of Fortune at Summerlin casino
stories.summary: The local player won $220,988.40 at a Summerlin casino while playing a $1.75 bet on a 25-cent denomination Wheel of Fortune machine.

stories.title: Suspect in fatal carjacking detained by federal judge after court appearance
stories.summary: He was arrested in connection with a Nov. 10 crash in which authorities said he struck and killed the owner of a truck he was in the process of stealing.

stories.title: College football betting: Ball State’s season is not over yet
stories.summary: Maybe these games will surprise us, but spreads of 9.5, 11 and 15 won’t have me, or anybody else, holding his or her breath for a good game.

stories.title: Fate of lawsuit seeking to recover millions in Las Vegas water penalties rests with judge
stories.summary: A judge will soon decide whether a lawsuit seeking to recover millions in water-use penalties from high-consuming Las Vegas homeowners can proceed as a class action involving tens of thousands of customers.

stories.title: Metro investigating east Las Vegas Valley shooting
stories.summary: Several people were detained on Monday after a person was shot in the east Las Vegas Valley and sought assistance at a nearby school, according to the Metropolitan Police Department.

stories.title: FEMA issues nationwide emergency alert test. Here’s what Nevadans need to know
stories.summary: A nationwide emergency test is scheduled Tuesday, but what does it actually mean and what can Nevadans expect?

stories.title: United Airlines resolves tech issue that affected departing flights
stories.summary: United Airlines said it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the FAA’s network prompted a nationwide ground stop.
